title: Prospective Exact-Cutoff Mediation Identification, Alpha–Beta Window Transition Instrumentation, Re-search/PVS Path Causality, Fresh Late-Opening Witness Replication & Patch-Stable Minimal Search-Transition Diagnostics

origin_fidelity.founding_question: Explaining Marginal Strategic Preferences Beyond Tactical Best Moves
origin_fidelity.required_chess_return: Every P12 mechanism claim must terminate in a legal root-candidate fate, PV replacement, or root-choice transition. Pure telemetry without candidate-move consequence is diagnostic only.
origin_fidelity.black_box_goal: Experimentally traverse board position -> exact search transition -> candidate branch fate -> root choice; do not equate one layer with another.
origin_fidelity.anti_drift: No new mechanism vocabulary unless an exact intervention separates live chess-search rivals prospectively.

harvest_donors.translation: An explanatory cutoff transition must earn authority by exact event intervention, not by temporal co-location.
P12 explicitly discriminates baseline-cutoff-loss, counterfactual-emergent-cutoff, and generic-search-reorganization rivals.
If exact cutoff intervention redirects rather than restores/reproduces the root choice, report nonidentification instead of attributing the effect to that cutoff.
No exact mediating transition under the frozen intervention set is a scientific result, not a reason to refine the A0 skeleton post hoc.

fresh_sources.hash_policy: Download exact monthly bytes, compute SHA-256 and seal them in the P12 corpus artifact before any engine outcome is consulted.
fresh_sources.freshness_rule: Exclude every recoverable P1-P11 candidate FEN hash and cross-source duplicate before selection.

late_opening_worlds.position_choice: Among eligible positions in each of the first 1,024 games, select the four lexicographically smallest fresh trajectory-position hashes after historical exclusion.

upstream_target.selection: All eligible baseline events up to max_targets_per_world, lexical exact address_id tie-break; no target outcome consulted.
upstream_target.root_change: Exact target removal changes legal root bestmove.

exact_cutoff_transition.candidate_rule: For a ROOT_CHANGE T_ONLY witness, align post-target CUTOFF streams by exact public address_id order. Freeze the first divergence as a pair: baseline-side disappearing/replaced cutoff B and T_ONLY-side emergent/replaced cutoff C. Either side may be null.
exact_cutoff_transition.private_alignment: Full TT key equality may be used only inside one engine trace to characterize revisit lineage; raw keys are never emitted.
exact_cutoff_transition.research_proxy: A later same-key same-ply occurrence after a NULL/NARROW event with strictly wider window, or changed fail-direction/window relation, is a bounded re-search/PVS proxy rather than a complete call-graph claim.

intervention_arms: B_ONLY exact baseline-side divergent CUTOFF removal when B exists
T_PLUS_C exact upstream target plus exact T_ONLY-side emergent CUTOFF removal when C exists

mediation_verdicts.EXACT_CUTOFF_BRIDGE: B_ONLY reaches the T_ONLY root move and T_PLUS_C restores the BASE root move.
mediation_verdicts.BASELINE_CUTOFF_SUFFICIENCY_ONLY: B_ONLY reaches the T_ONLY root move but T_PLUS_C does not restore BASE.
mediation_verdicts.COUNTERFACTUAL_CUTOFF_NECESSITY_ONLY: T_PLUS_C restores BASE but B_ONLY does not reach T_ONLY.
mediation_verdicts.EXACT_CUTOFF_INTERACTION_REDIRECT: B_ONLY or T_PLUS_C reaches a third legal root move.
mediation_verdicts.CUTOFF_COLOCATION_ONLY: Exact cutoff pair exists but neither exact intervention satisfies sufficiency/necessity.
mediation_verdicts.NO_EXACT_CUTOFF_PAIR: No post-target first cutoff divergence pair exists under the frozen rule.
mediation_verdicts.ADDRESS_DRIFT: A frozen exact event does not fire in its required arm.

required: baseline root move UCI and SAN
T_ONLY root move UCI and SAN
B_ONLY/T_PLUS_C root move UCI and SAN when executed
first PV divergence ply and legal SAN prefix when available
chess_native_surface.human_strategy_labels: Not primary evidence. Tactical/strategic prose may summarize verified move/PV facts only.

support_gate.rationale: Exposure floor set before P12 outcomes from parent P10 density: 180 frozen-skeleton records across 27 worlds; P12 requires a conservative nonzero exposure floor rather than treating the proportional expectation (~240/36 worlds) as a minimum.

replication_rule.same_transition_signature: bound_sign + baseline cutoff fail_direction/window_class/revisit_kind + counterfactual cutoff fail_direction/window_class/revisit_kind + mediation_verdict

patch_stability.baseline: P11 NONE mode must remain transparent on the seven-case bank.
patch_stability.p11_bound_patch: LOWER/UPPER/BOTH outcomes may be reported as inherited patch-stability context but cannot vote in P12 fresh science.
patch_stability.fresh_p12_patch: No new behavioral patch is required unless exact mediation identifies a repeated transition signature prospectively.

implementation_roles.C_or_Cpp: Reuse exact P32 event intervention and P11/P34 observer chain; add native instrumentation only if required for a frozen observable unavailable from the existing trace.
implementation_roles.Python: Fresh corpus, target-blind skeleton sampling, exact cutoff-pair selection, event interventions, chess-native SAN/PV diagnostics and adjudication.
implementation_roles.JavaScript: Claim firewall, raw-key prohibition and chess-native diagnostic completeness.

stop_rule: Do not retrospectively split P10/P11 A0.
Do not search for a later cutoff if the frozen first-divergence pair fails mediation.
Do not convert re-search proxy into exact PVS-call authority.
Do not create a new patch merely to rescue a failed exact mediation result.
Close after fresh support, exact cutoff adjudication, chess-native diagnostics and bounded patch-stability report.
claim_ceiling: P12 identifies only exact event-level search mediation under the declared engines, node budget, history protocol and fresh late-opening sample.
A repeated cutoff transition signature is not a universal chess or engine mechanism.
Same-key revisit/window widening is an operational re-search/PVS proxy unless engine-native call identity is separately instrumented.
Root-move change is engine choice behavior, not proof of objective chess correctness or human strategic intent.
Human chess language is downstream of verified legal-move, PV and search-transition facts.
